name: /sdd:generate-tasks: numbers criteria and says which spec criterion they cover
prompt:
/sdd:generate-tasks .specs/docs/specs/phase-1_widget-list.md

Go ahead and write the task file, to .specs/docs/tasks/phase-1/1.01-list-widgets-endpoint.md exactly.

graders.why: an unnumbered criterion cannot be cited by converge or analyze, and the numbering is the whole of what this phase added to the generator
coverage is declared, never inferred. Without the annotation the spec criterion reads as covered by nothing, however obviously the task delivers it
the spec numbers SC-01 and SC-02 only. A reference to any other number is a dangling pointer that analyze will report, and it is the failure mode of filling in an annotation to look thorough
